description: Logs and state emitted by a local anvil chain (no fork) running one ZeroSeedLaunch extension and its ZeroSeedLaunchPeriphery over the main Core runtime, with native-ETH and plain-ERC-20 quote launches on the same extension and swaps through the compiled test/LaunchTestRouter.sol. Supplies are raw launch-token units as decimal strings: requestedSupply = LaunchParameters.supply = totalSupply, installedSupply = Core PositionUpdated launch-token delta of the creation, sinkSupply = requested - installed = balanceOf(address(0)). Local fixture, not live evidence.

provenance.buildSubmodules: excluded from git dirty check; canonical ABI, creation code and runtime template checked independently

instances.label: local
instances.scope: one extension and periphery for every quote (native ETH and the relocated plain test ERC-20 here), local only
